newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Germany has moved stance on EMU pact - Asbrink.
newsitem.headline: Germany has moved stance on EMU pact - Asbrink.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink voiced optimism about the chances that his EU colleagues would succeed in reaching a deal on Thursday night on a pact to enforce fiscal discipline after monetary union.

Asbrink told reporters that German Finance Minister Theo Waigel had shown openness on the issue and "has moved" his position. But Asbrink stressed, "Nothing is ready and accepted." He said there had been a Belgian compromise proposal.

Germany has been isolated at the finance ministers' talks in Dublin in holding out for a strict definition of the circumstances in which a country should be exempt from fines for running an excessive fiscal deficit under the EU's planned monetary union.
